steps.title: Dooro wax la yaqaan
steps.text: Sawirro koob shaah, beero, xayawaan guri iyo doonyo shiraac. Waxba lama akhriyo, sharciyo horey loogu barto ma jiraan.

steps.title: Dhinac dhinac u fadhiiso
steps.text: Ha taabto. Ka wada hadla sawirrada. Sawir aan isku mid ahayn wuxuu sugayaa taabashada xigta.

steps.title: Joogso inta ay wanaagsan tahay
steps.text: Hal ciyaar waa waxqabad dhammaystiran. “Hadda waan joojinayaa” had iyo jeer waa shaashadda.

home.stageTitle: Fikrado waxqabad oo loogu talagalay marxalad kasta
home.stageLede: Muusiko, hawlaha maalinlaha ah, xusuusta waayihii hore iyo daqiiqado deggan oo dareenka ah, oo la jaan qaadaya waxa hadda raaxada ah.

stages.title: Marxaladda hore
stages.text: Sii wad waxa ay jecel yihiin, oo wax yar ku hagaaji: hiwaayado, safarro, ciyaaro ereyo iyo qorshayn wadajir ah.
stages.label: Fikrado marxaladda hore

stages.title: Marxaladda dhexe
stages.text: Hawlo fudud oo la yaqaan oo qaybo loo kala jaray: laablaabid, kala-saarid, muusiko, ciyaaro sawir iyo socod gaaban.
stages.label: Fikrado marxaladda dhexe

stages.title: Marxaladda dambe
stages.text: Raaxo iyo xiriir iyada oo loo marayo taabasho, dhawaaq iyo aragti: daryeelka gacmaha, heesaha la jecel yahay, sawirro iyo la joogid.
stages.label: Fikrado marxaladda dambe

home.specificHtml: Ma doonaysaa wax gaar ah? Isku day dhaqdhaqaaqyo iyo ciyaaro loogu talagalay Alzheimer's, qoraalo iyo ciyaaro miis, ciyaaro wada hadal ama qoraalo.
home.approachTitle: Dhaqdhaqaaq wada samaysan, ma aha imtixaan
home.approachLede: Ciyaaro badan oo “maskaxda” loogu talagalay waxaa lagu dhisay xawaare, dhibco iyo guuleysi isku xigta. Qof daallan, xanuunsan ama qaba dementia, taasi waxay u eka tahay imtixaan. Waxaan sameynay wax ka soo horjeeda.

principles.title: Waxba lagu guuldaraysan maayo
principles.text: Saacad, dhibco, nolol ama lumis ma jiro. Sawir ka duwan waa nasasho, ma aha qalad.

principles.title: Sawirradu way muuqdaan
principles.text: Aqoonsiga ayaa ka horreeya xusuusta. Isku-mid-ka wuxuu ku bilaabmaa sawirro la fiiriyo, sidaas darteed waxba lama xusuusto.

principles.title: Qof weyn iyo sharaf leh
principles.text: Erayo diirran oo fudud iyo sawirro dhab ah. Marnaba ma jiraan kartuun ama hadal ilmo.

principles.title: Gaar ahaan loo ilaaliyay
principles.text: Akoon ama xayeysiis ma jiro. Sawirradaadu qalabkaaga ma ka baxaan.

home.researchTitle: Caafimaadka maskaxda: waxa cilmi-baarisu runtii sheegto
home.researchText: Ma laga hortagi karaa dementia? Ma caawiyaan ciyaaraha maskaxda? Maxaa ku saabsan soonka, cuntada, hurdada iyo maqalka? Jawaabo fudud oo ilo leh, oo ay ku jiraan meesha caddaynta daciifka tahay.
home.appTitle: Creative Activities oo ku yaal iPhone, iPad iyo Android
home.appText: App-ka bilaashka ah wuxuu shaqeeyaa internet la’aan, wuxuuna isticmaali karaa sawirro qoys oo aad doorato, oo ah nuqulo qalabkaaga ku jira. Naqshad deggan oo isku mid ah: afar kaar oo waaweyn, saacad la’aan, dhibco la’aan.

faq.q: Waa maxay ciyaaraha wanaagsan ee dadka waaweyn?
faq.a: Ciyaaraha wanaagsan waa kuwo fudud, la yaqaan oo aan cadaado lahayn: sawirro waaweyn oo la isku keeno, kala soocid, qoraalo fudud, dhammaystirka hadallo caan ah, midabeynta, bingo-ga sawirada iyo kaararka wada hadalka. Waxay ku habboon yihiin dad badan oo waaweyn, oo ay ku jiraan dadka qaba dementia. Doorashada ugu fiican waa midda qofku maanta ku farxo. Ka fogow saacadaha, dhibcaha iyo wax kasta oo u eka imtixaan.

Haa. Ciyaar kasta iyo waxa la daabaci karo ee Creative Activities waa bilaash, akoon, diiwaan gelin ama soo dejin looma baahna. Ciyaaruhu waxay ka shaqeeyaan biraawsarka taleefan, taablad ama kombuyuutar.

faq.q: Ma ka hortagaan ciyaaraha maskaxdu dementia?
faq.a: Ma jiro ciyaar la caddeeyay inay ka hortagto dementia, Creative Activities mana sheegto inay wax daaweyso ama ka hortagto. Ciyaaradayada waxay u yihiin farxad iyo waqti wadajir ah, bogagga dhaqdhaqaaqyadu ma sheegaan wax caafimaad oo ku saabsan.

faq.q: Ma ku habboon yihiin ciyaarahan qof qaba Alzheimer?
faq.a: Haa. Cudurka Alzheimer waa sababta ugu badan ee dementia, ciyaaraha waxaa loo sameeyay: sawirro waaweyn oo muuqda, doorashooyin yar, iyo wax aan la xusuusan ama la khaldin. Isku-mid-ka, kala-saarista iyo dhammaystirka hadallada la yaqaan waxay ku tiirsan yihiin aqoon hore oo la haysto, ma aha barasho cusub.

faq.q: Ma isticmaali karaa qof ku jira marxaladda dambe ee dementia waxqabadyadan?
faq.a: Inta badan, haa, haddii qof ag fadhiisto. Ka bilow Raadi kan isku mid ah oo laba sawir leh, Lammaanaha sawirrada oo afar kaar leh, bog midabayn ama nasasho neefsasho deggan. Ka dhig mid gaaban, raac hogaankooda oo joojii markay ku ekaadaan.

Degelku akoon iyo xayeysiis ma laha. Waxaan isticmaalnaa Google Analytics si aan u fahanno bogagga la booqdo. Sawirrada aad u doorato Lammaanaha sawirrada qoyska waxay ka muuqdaan biraawsarkaaga oo keliya, mana la soo geliyo.

Creative Activities waa koox yar oo samaysa dhaqdhaqaaqyo abuur oo degan oo waaweyn, loogu talagalay qof kasta oo daryeelaya qof, oo ku yaal shabakadda iyo app bilaash ah. Innagu ma nihin dhakhaatiir, wixii halkan ku jira ma aha talo caafimaad.

healthNotice.title: Macluumaad guud, ma aha talo caafimaad
healthNotice.textHtml: Boggan wuxuu soo koobayaa cilmi-baaris la daabacay oo loogu talagalay qoysaska. Ma sheegi karo waxa u fiican hal qof. La hadal dhakhtar ka hor intaanad beddelin cuntada, jimicsiga, hurdada, dawooyinka ama dheeriyayaasha cuntada. Marka ay jirto jahwareer kedis ah ama isbeddel kale oo kedis ah, isla markiiba hel caawimaad caafimaad. Akhri ogaysiiskeena macluumaadka caafimaadka.

about.bodyHtml:
Yuu u tala galay

Qof kasta oo daryeelaya qof kale: waalid, awoowe, ilmo, lammaane, saaxiib, ama qof la noolaada dementia. Qoysaska, dadka waaweyn iyo shaqaalaha dhaqdhaqaaqa oo dhan waxay isticmaali karaan isla bogagga.

Waxa aan rumaysanahay

Muhiimada dhaqdhaqaaqu waa waqtiga laftiisa: wada hadal, dhoola-cadeyn, farxadda ah in laba sawir isku dhex geeyo, ama kaliya in isku dhow fadhiisto. Ma aha in qof la qiyaaso, in lagu riixo ama in wax la caddeeyo.

Barnaamijyo badan oo tababarka maskaxda ah waxaa loo qorsheeyay xawaare, dhibcood, silsilad guulaha iyo heerarka. Qof daallan, jirran ama la noolaada dementia, taasi waxay u muuqan kartaa imtixaan aan gabi ahaanba gudbi karin. Annagu waxa aan sameynay ka soo horjeeda, waxaana iska ilaalinaa xeerarkan:

  • Wax aan la guuldaysto ma jiro. Saacad, dhibco, tirinta tallaabooyinka, nolosha ciyaarta, silsiladaha guulaha, confetti ama tirinta dib-u-celinta, ma jiraan shaashad kasta.
  • Aqoonsi ka mudan xusuusta. Sawirku wuxuu had iyo jeer muuqan doonaa. Su'aalaha waxay dhiirrigelinayaan wada hadal, mana ay imtixaamin magacyada ama xusuusta.
  • Waa weyn, fudud, oo xasilloon. Qoraal iyo sawirro waaweyn, iftiin-kala-soocid sare, iyo badhamada oo had iyo jeer meel isku mid ah ku sugan.
  • Sharaf qaangaar. Sawirro dhab ah iyo erayo fudud oo diirran. Ma jiraan sawirro majaajilo, ammaan u dhawaaqaysa ama abaalmarin emoji ah.
  • Jid fudud oo laga baxo. “Hadda way dhammaatay” had iyo jeer ayaa muuqda. Dhexdhexaad ka joojinta waa natiijo wanaagsan.
  • Gaar ahaan had iyo jeer. Akoon ma lihid, xayaysiis ma jiro. Sawirada aad dooratid qalabkaaga ayey ku sii jiraan.

Waxa aynaan sheegin

Ciyaaraha iyo dhaqdhaqaaqyadayadu waxay u yihiin raaxo iyo xiriir. Ma ogaaneyaan, ma tijaabiyaan, ma cabbiraan, ma daaweeyaan, ma gaabiyaan, ma ka hortagayaan dementia ama cudurka Alzheimer’s, mana ay tahay in qof uu dooranayo iyaga sababtaas darteed. Markaan qoraayo cilmi-baarista caafimaadka, si cad ayaan u sheegnaa meesha caddaynta ay daciif tahay, mana aan xiriirinno dhaqdhaqaaqyadayada.

Ayaynu nahay

Creative Activities waa koox yar oo madax-bannaan. Annagu dhakhaatiir ma nahan. Hagayaashayadu waxay ku salaysan yihiin tilmaamaha la daabacay ee ururro sida National Institute on Aging iyo Alzheimer’s Association, hagaha kastaa wuxuu liistaa ilihiisa macluumaadka. Akhri sida aynu bogagayaga u qorno oo u hubino.

Noo sheeg waxa caawin kara

Aad ayaan u jeclaan lahayn inaad na sheegto waxa kuu shaqeeya iyo waxa aan shaqeyn, gaar ahaan dadka la noolaada dementia, daryeelayaasha qoyska iyo shaqaalaha dhaqdhaqaaqa. E-mail u dir {email}.

editorial.title: Sida aan u qorno oo aan u hubinno bogagga
editorial.description: Sida Creative Activities u cilmi-baarto, u qorto, u helo ilaha macluumaadka, una cusboonaysiiso bogagga dhaqdhaqaaqa iyo caafimaadka, iyo waxa aan weligeen daabici doonin.
editorial.bodyHtml:
Our sources

We base our guides on public guidance from organizations such as the National Institute on Aging, the CDC, the Alzheimer’s Association, the Alzheimer’s Foundation of America, the Family Caregiver Alliance and the NHS, and on peer-reviewed research such as Cochrane reviews and large clinical trials. Every guide lists the sources it relies on. We open each source before citing it, and we only report what it actually says.

How we write

  • Practical first: what to do today, in plain language.
  • Honest about evidence: we say “linked with”, “may” and “the evidence is mixed” when that is the truth.
  • Respectful: we write about people living with dementia as adults, and we never use quizzing or shaming language.
  • No invented content: no made-up statistics, quotes, experts, studies, reviews or testimonials.

Who reviews our pages

Pages are written and checked by the Creative Activities team. Some drafting and research use AI tools, as described below. Every page is checked against its sources by the team. Our pages have not been reviewed by a doctor or other clinician, and we do not claim otherwise. They are general information, not medical advice.

How AI is used

We use AI tools to help with research, first drafts, translation drafts and formatting. A person edits every page against its sources. AI does not test activities: a person tries each activity before it is published. No AI-generated step, image or review is presented as verified, and we do not publish AI-written reviews or testimonials. No generated image is shown as a photo of a real activity.

What we will never publish

  • Claims that a game, food, supplement, fast or routine prevents, treats, slows or cures dementia.
  • Tests, quizzes or scores that suggest someone has, or does not have, dementia.
  • Advice to start, stop or change any medicine.
  • Advertising or sponsored content disguised as guidance.

Updates and corrections

Each page shows the date it was last updated. If you find a mistake or an out-of-date source, please email {email} and we will check it promptly.

faq.title: Su’aalo iyo jawaabo
faq.seoTitle: Su'aalaha iyo Jawaabaha ku saabsan Creative Activities
faq.description: Jawaabo su'aalaha caadiga ah ee ku saabsan ciyaaraha iyo dhaqdhaqaaqyada: waxa la isku dayo, intee wakhti la ciyaaro, kooxaha iyo fikradaha marxaladaha dambe, caafimaadka iyo asturnaanta.
faq.lede: Jawaabo gaaban oo fudud oo ku saabsan su’aalaha daryeelayaashu ugu badan weydiiyaan.

items.q: Waa maxay ciyaaraha ugu wanaagsan dadka da' weyn?
items.a: Ciyaaraha ugu fiican waa kuwa la yaqaan, fudud oo cadaadis la’aan ah, kan sax ahna waa kan uu qofku maanta ku farxo. Isku-mid-ka sawirrada la muujiyay, kala-saarid, jigsaw fudud, dhammaystirka hadallo la yaqaan, midabayn iyo bingo sawir dad badan ayay u shaqeeyaan. Iska ilaali saacado, dhibco iyo wax kasta oo u eg imtixaan.

items.q: Ma runtii bilaash bay yihiin ciyaaruhu?
items.a: Haa. Dhammaan ciyaaraha iyo waxa la daabaci karo waa bilaash, akoon, diiwaan gelin, soo dejin ama xayeysiis la’aan.

items.q: Maxay u jirin dhibco, heerar ama saacado?
items.a: Xawaaraha iyo dhibcuhu waxay waxqabad wacan u beddelaan imtixaan, taas oo keeni karta ceeb ama niyad-jab. Waxaan diiradda saarnaa raaxo iyo wakhti la wada qaato, sidaas darteed waxba lagu guuldaraysan maayo, wakhti kasta ayaad joojin kartaa.

Taleefan, taablad ama kombuyuutar kasta oo leh biraawsar casri ah. Taablad taagan miis dusiisa inta badan waa habka ugu raaxada badan ee laba qof dhinac dhinac ugu ciyaari karaan. Laptop ku xiran TV ayaa ku wanaagsan kooxaha.

items.q: Ma ku ciyaari karnaa sawirradeenna qoys?
items.a: Haa. Lammaanaha sawirrada qoyska wuxuu 2 ilaa 6 sawir oo aad doorato u beddelaa ciyaar isku-mid ah. Sawirradu waxay ku hadhaan biraawsarkaaga, mana la soo geliyo ama la keydiyo.

items.q: Intee in le’eg waxqabadku waa inuu socdaa?
items.a: Inta badan 10 ilaa 20 daqiiqo way ku filan tahay, mararka qaarkoodna 2 daqiiqo waa guul. Ka feejignow calaamadaha daalka ama niyad-jabka, oo joogso inta ay wanaagsan tahay. Inta saxda ah ma jirto.

items.q: Haddii ay doonayn inay waxqabad sameeyaan?
items.a: Ixtiraam diidmada, oo mar dambe ama si kale isku day. Diidmadu waxay ka imaan kartaa daal, xanuun, shaki ama si fudud xiiso la’aan. Eeg hagheenna ku saabsan waxa la sameeyo marka ay dhahaan maya.

items.q: Waxqabadyo maxay ku habboon yihiin dementia marxaladda dambe?
items.a: Raaxo iyo dareenka: dhegaysiga muusiko la jecel yahay, daawada gacmaha oo la shiiqiyo, sawirro la wada eego, go’ jilicsan oo la haysto, banaanka oo la fadhiisto, ama ciyaar sawir oo aad u fudud oo qof dhinac ku fadhiisto. Hagheenna marxaladda dambe wuxuu leeyahay fikrado badan oo kale.

items.q: Ma jiraan waxqabadyo kooxeed oo guri daryeel ah?
items.a: Haa. Bingo sawirku wuxuu leeyahay kaararka la daabaci karo iyo qof ku dhawaaqa shaashadda, Dhammaystirka hadalka iyo Kaararka wadahadalku si wanaagsan ayay ugu shaqeeyaan marka kor loo akhriyo. Hagheenna kooxaha guriga daryeelku wuxuu ka hadlaa cabbirka kooxda, fadhiga iyo la jaan qaadidda awoodaha kala duwan.

items.q: Ma ka hortagi ama gaabin karaan ciyaaruhu dementia?
items.a: Ciyaar lama muujin inay ka hortagto dementia, ciyaaraheennuna sheegasho caynkaas ah ma sameeyaan. Kicinta garashada ee goob bulsheed waxay cilmi-baaris ku muujisay faa’iidooyin yar dadka qaba dementia fudud ilaa dhexdhexaad, laakiin taasi way ka duwan tahay ciyaar ka hortagta cudur. Waxaan bixinnaa ciyaaro loogu talagalay raaxo iyo xiriir.

Hubaal ma aha. Cilmi-baarisu waxay xiriirisaa 14 arrimood oo caafimaad iyo hab-nololeed khatarta dementia, sida maqal dhimis, cadaadis dhiig sare, dhaqdhaqaaq la’aan jireed iyo go’doomin bulsheed. Wax ka qabashadooda waxay yarayn kartaa khatarta dadka qaarkood, laakiin dad badan oo wax walba si sax ah sameeya ayaa weli qaba dementia. Marnaba ma aha cidna qalad.

items.q: Ma wanaagsan tahay soonka go’go’an ee caafimaadka maskaxda?
items.a: Caddaynta dadka ku saabsan way xadidan tahay oo way hore tahay, cilmi-baaris badanna waxay ku jirtaa xayawaanka. Soonku wuxuu khatar u noqon karaa dadka waaweyn, gaar ahaan marka dawooyinka sonkorowga la isticmaalo ama miisaanka si aan loogu talagalin loo luuqo, lamana talinayo dadka ku nool dementia. La hadal dhakhtar ka hor intaanad beddelin sida aad u cuntid.

Akoon ama xayeysiis ma jiraan. Waxaan isticmaalnaa Google Analytics si aan u tirinno booqashooyinka oo aan u aragno bogagga caawiya, biraawsarkaaguna wuu xasuustaa haddii aad daartay codadka jilicsan. Sawirrada aad u doorato Lammaanaha sawirrada qoyska marnaba lama soo geliyo. Eeg ogaysiiska asturnaanta faahfaahin dheeraad ah.
Maya. Creative Activities waa madadaalo iyo macluumaad guud. Su’aalaha caafimaadka la hadal dhakhtar, xaalad degdeg ah na wac lambarka gurmadka degdegga ah ee gobolkaaga.

faq.moreHtml: Faahfaahin dheeraad ah: sida wada ciyaaro, marka ay yiraahdaan maya, dhaqdhaqaaqyada marxaladda dambe iyo dhaqdhaqaaqyada dementia-da ee guriga.

handout.title: Ciyaaro Deggan oo Bilaash ah, Dadka ku nool Dementia
handout.seoTitle: Warqad la daabaco: Ciyaaro Dementia oo Bilaash ah
handout.description: Warqad hal bog ah oo la daabaci karo oo qoysaska iyo daryeelayaasha loogu talagalay, ku saabsan ciyaaro sawir oo deggan oo bilaash ah, kooxaha taageerada.
handout.lede: Daabac boggan koox taageero, xirmo daryeel ama albaabka qaboojiyaha. Isticmaal amarka Daabac ee biraawsarkaaga; liisaska iyo badhamada waa laga tagayaa.
handout.introHtml: Sawirro waaweyn, erayo fudud iyo waxba lagu guuldaraysan maayo. Bilaash ah taleefan, taablad ama kombuyuutar, diiwaan gelin, xayeysiis, saacad ama dhibco la’aan. Dhinac dhinac u fadhiiso oo isu beddela.
handout.restHtml:
Dhowr talo

  • Dooro wakhti maalinta ah oo qofku uu ugu fiican yahay.
  • Ka bilow habka ugu fudud. Afar kaar way ku filan yihiin.
  • Ka hadal sawirrada. Wadahadalku inta badan waa qaybta ugu fiican.
  • Joogso inta ay wali raaxo tahay. Hore u dhammaystirku waa natiijo wanaagsan.

Sidoo kale degelka

  • Waxyaabo la daabaci karo oo bilaash ah: raadinta ereyada daabacaad weyn, bogagga midabaynta, kaararka wadahadalka iyo bingo sawir.
  • Fikrado waxqabad oo loogu talagalay marxalad kasta, iyo hagayaal ku saabsan wada ciyaarka iyo naftaada daryeelka.

Loogu talagalay raaxo iyo wakhti la wada qaato. Ma aha talo caafimaad, imtixaan ama daaweyn. Creative Activities waxaa daabacay Cloudjet Solutions Pte. Ltd.

organizations.description: Sida guryaha daryeelka, barnaamijyada maalinta ee dadka waaweyn, maktabadaha, hay'adaha da'da iyo kooxaha taageerada ay u isticmaalaan ciyaaraheena bilaashka ah iyo hagayaasha dhaqdhaqaaqa, iyo qoraal lagu daro liiska ilaha.
organizations.lede: Wax kasta oo degelkan ku jira waa bilaash in lagu isticmaalo dadka deggan, xubnaha iyo macaamiisha, akoon, shati ama kharash la’aan.
organizations.shortText: {name}: ciyaaro sawiro oo bilaash ah oo fudud iyo hagayaal dhaqdhaqaaq oo loogu talagalay dadka waaweyn, qoysaska iyo dadka la noolaada dementia. Ma jiro diiwaan-galin, ma jiro saacado, ma jiro dhibco.
organizations.longText: {name} ({domain}) wuxuu bixiyaa {count} ciyaar oo browser-ka ku shaqeeya oo bilaash ah oo loogu talagalay dadka waayeelka ah, qoysaska iyo dadka ku nool dementia. Ciyaarahaas waxaa ka mid ah lammaanayaal sawirku muuqdo, furfuris qayb-qayb fudud, kala-soocid, maahmaahyo caan ah iyo bingo sawir oo leh kaararka la daabici karo. Ma jirto akoon, xayaysiis, saacad ama dhibcood. Degelkan waxaa kaloo ku jira hagayaal firfircoonida oo qoraal sahlan ku qoran oo loogu talagalay qoysaska, dadka waayeelka ah iyo shaqaalaha, oo ay ku jiraan ilo sida National Institute on Aging iyo Alzheimer's Association.
organizations.gamesItemHtml: {count} ciyaar biraawsar oo ka shaqeeya laptop, taablad ama TV ku xiran kombuyuutar. Rakibaad, akoon ama soo dejin ma jiro. Eeg dhammaan ciyaaraha.
organizations.printablesAfter: Isticmaal badhanka Daabac ee bog kasta.
organizations.moreItemsHtml:
• Qaababka kooxda: Bingo sawir wuxuu leeyahay kaararka la daabici karo iyo qof shaashadda ku akhrinaya lambarrada, ciyaaraha wada-hadalka wuxuu leeyahay su'aalo leh doorashooyin jawaab iyo mawduucyo wada-hadal.
  • Hagayaal firfircoonida oo loogu talagalay shaqaalaha iyo qoysaska, oo qoraal sahlan ku qoran oo leh ilo. Ka bilow 101 fikradood oo firfircoonida ama firfircoonida kooxda ee guryaha daryeelka.
organizations.restHtml:
Sida kooxuhu u isticmaalaan

  • Guryaha daryeelka iyo daryeelka xusuusta: bingo sawir ama dhammaystirka hadalka oo TV-ga qolka guud ah ku yaal, hal qof oo koox u taabanaya.
  • Barnaamijyada maalinta ee dadka waaweyn: xarun taablad oo leh Lammaanaha sawirrada oo la dejiyay afar kaar, kulammo gaaban oo hal-qof-hal-qof ah.
  • Maktabadaha dadweynaha: raadinta ereyada la daabacay iyo kaararka wadahadalka oo ku jira xirmooyinka xusuusta, iyo degelka oo lagu calaamadiyay taablad-yada maktabadda.
  • Kooxaha taageerada daryeelayaasha iyo goobaha qaxwada xusuusta: warqad hal bog ah oo la daabaci karo oo qoysaska guriga u qaadan karaan.
  • Isbitaallada iyo qorsheeyaasha bixitaanka: warqadda oo la geliyo xirmooyinka daryeelayaasha, si wax deggan guriga ama sariirta agteeda looga sameeyo.

Waxa aanan samayn

Ciyaaraha waxaa loogu talagalay raaxo iyo wakhti la wada qaato. Ma baaraan, ma tijaabiyaan, ma dhibcaan, ma daaweeyaan, mana gaabiyaan dementia, annaguna waxaan weydiisannaa hay’aduhu inayan sidaas u tilmaamin. Xayeysiis ma jiro, ciyaaruhuna ma weydiiyaan magacyo, faahfaahin caafimaad ama sawirro la soo geliyo. Degelku wuxuu isticmaalaa Google Analytics si uu u tiriyo booqashooyinka; ogaysiiskeena asturnaanta wuxuu sharraxayaa waxa uu ururiyo. Sawirrada loo isticmaalo Lammaanaha sawirrada qoyska waxay ku hadhaan biraawsarka.

Naga dar liiskaaga ilaha

Haddii aad haysato liis ilo ah oo daryeelayaasha loogu talagalay, waad ku soo dhaweyn tahay inaad ku xirto {domain}. Waxaad koobiyeyn kartaa sharraxaad kasta.
organizations.linksHtml:
Bogag waxtar leh oo si toos ah loogu xidhi karo: ciyaaro bilaash ah, waraaqo bilaash ah oo la daabici karo, firfircoonida dementia ee guriga iyo sida wada loo ciyaaro.

Su'aalo ama saxitaan

Haddii wax ka mid ah degelka qaldan yahay ama aan cad ahayn, ama baahiyaha qof deganaya aan lagu qanacsanayn waxa halkan ku jira, fadlan noo sheeg {email}. Fadlan ha soo dirin macluumaad shakhsi ah ama caafimaad oo ku saabsan dadka deganaya ama macaamiisha.

app.title: App-ka Creative Activities
app.seoTitle: App-ka Creative Activities ee iPhone iyo Android
app.description: App-ka bilaashka ah ee Creative Activities: isku-mid sawir oo deggan, afar kaar oo waaweyn, sawirro qoys oo qalabkaaga ku jira, xirmooyin internet la’aan ah.
app.lede: Wax kasta oo aad ka jeceshahay degelka, app ku jira oo internet la’aan ka shaqeeya oo isticmaali kara sawirro qoys oo aad doorato.
app.bodyHtml:
Ka bilow yar

Ku bilow afar kaar oo waaweyn iyo sawirro la yaqaan. Ku hay sawirrada muuqda, ama qari marka ay raaxo tahay. Qaabka deggan wuxuu leeyahay saacad, dhibco ama ciqaab midna ma jiraan. Dooro 4, 6, 8 ama 12 kaar.

Ka dhig mid adiga kuu gaar ah

Dooro sawirro qoys adigoo isticmaalaya doorashada sawirrada ee qalabkaaga. App-ku wuxuu u kaydiyaa nuqulo yaryar waxqabadyadiisa. Ma baarto maktabaddaada, mana beddelo sawirradaada asalka ah, wuxuuna ku hayaa ilaa 24 sawir hal ururin.

Si fudud u wada eeg

Eeg hal sawir mar kasta. Su’aalaha ikhtiyaariga ah waxay martiqaadaan wadahadal iyadoo aan lagu weydiin qofna inuu xusuusto magacyo ama uu bixiyo jawaab sax ah. Eegis keliya waa ku filan tahay.

Internet la’aan meesha ay muhiim tahay

Sawirrada bilowga ah iyo dhammaan sideedda xirmo ee sawirrada waxay la socdaan app-ka. Nuqulada sawirrada la soo geliyay waxay shaqeeyaan internet la’aan. Doorashada sawirro asal ah oo ku kaydsan iCloud oo keliya waxay u baahan kartaa xiriir internet.

Akoon ama serfar sawir-wadaag ma jiro

Nuqulada sawirrada qoyska waxay ku hadhaan app-ka qalabka. Waxaad ka saari kartaa nuqulada adigoon tirtirin sawirrada asalka ah. Backup-yada qalabka waxaa laga yaabaa inay ku jiraan xogta app-ka. Akhri siyaasadda asturnaanta ee app-ka, caawimaadda app-kuna waxay kaa soo marisaa tallaabo kasta.
app.disclaimer: Creative Activities waxaa loogu talagalay madadaalo iyo wadahadal la wadaago. Ma baarto, ma daaweyso, ma ka hortagto, mana cabbirto dementia ama cudurka Alzheimer.

gamePage.photoAppText: App-ka bilaashka ah ee Creative Activities, sawirrada aad doorato waxay ku hadhaan qalabkaaga marka xigta, ciyaaruhuna waxay ka shaqeeyaan Wi‑Fi la’aan. iPhone, iPad iyo Android.
gamePage.goodToKnowText: Ciyaartan waxaa loogu talagalay raaxo iyo wakhti la wada qaato. Ma tijaabiso, ma cabbirto, mana daaweyso wax.

print.heading: Ku ciyaaro warqad
print.sameRules: Nooca warqadda wuxuu leeyahay isla xeerarka ciyaarta shaashadda:
print.pageNote: Hal bog oo A4 ama US Letter ah, oo ku habboon madow iyo cadaan. Nooca {date}.
print.islandNote: Waxay daabacaysaa waxa shaashadda ku jira hadda. Nooca {date}.
print.point: Warqadda ku saar, halkii aad taabanaysid sawirka, tilmaan ku sii ama wareeg ku dhig qalin. Safka kasta waa qaybta cusub.
print.pointTarget: Warqadda, sawirka la eegayo waa sanduuqa ku yaal bilowga safka kasta. Halkii aad taabanaysid sawirka, tilmaan ku sii ama wareeg ku dhig qalin.
print.halves: Sawir kasta waa la gooyaa dhexdiisa. Xariiq ka samee nuska bidixda ilaa nuska midig ee ku habboon, ama tilmaan farta. Waxba ma gooyo.
print.grid: Jibbaaran kasta wuxuu leeyahay lambar. Lambarkaas ka raadi furaha, kadibna jibbaaraha ku rinji pencil midabkiisa. Midab kasta oo kale oo aad doorato ayaa sidoo kale fiican. Waxba ma gooyo.
print.colors: Safka kasta wuxuu magacaabayaa midab. Tilmaan sawir kasta oo midabkaas leh, ama wareeg ku dhig qalin. Safka kasta waa qaybta cusub.
print.dice: Safka kasta waa kooxo sawir (dice) ah. Dooro hal safka, ama gooy sawirada oo mid mid ka soo qaad, kadibna sheeg sheeko iyagoo siday rabtaan u isticmaalaya. Qof kasta wuu dhaafi karaa.
print.words: Ereyada gooy, ama xariiq ka samee erey kasta ilaa sawirkiisa. Ereyada si hadal ah u akhri intaad socotid.
print.cards: Kaararka ka gooy khadadka xariijimaysan. Miiska ku saar iyagoo sawirka muuqda, kadibna raadi lammaanayaasha.
print.chain: Warqadda sawirada ka akhri bidix ilaa midig, mid kadib mid kale. Qof kasta wuxuu ku odhan doonaa hal jumlo ku saabsan sawirada ilaa hadda, kadibna wuxuu tilmaamayaa sawirka xiga. Qof kasta wuu dhaafi karaa.
print.sort: Sawirada ka gooy khadadka xariijimaysan, kadibna mid kasta geli sanduuqa uu ku habboon yahay.
print.puzzle: Sawirka weyn ka gooy afar qaybood khadadka xariijimaysan, kadibna isku walaaq. Laba qaybood mar wada beddel ilaa sawirku dhammaystiro. Sawirka yar waa hage.
print.cutSafety: Caawiye ayaa gooynta ku samayn kara ka hor intaadan bilaabin. Kadib, gunnada dib u dhig meel ammaan ah.

reasons.photos: Ma jiro nooc warqad ah. Ciyaartan waxay isticmaashaa sawirradaada, kuwaas oo ku sii jira browser-kaaga oo weligood lama soo rarin, sidaas darteed degelku ma daabici karo. Si aad warqad ugu ciyaarto, labo nuqul ka daabac sawirro kuugu jecel oo guriga ku jira, kadibna miiska ku lammaani.
reasons.paced: Ma jiro nooc warqad ah. Wareegga shaashadda wuxuu dejiyaa xawaare tartan yar oo joogto ah, taasna bog la daabacay ma samayn karo, sidaas darteed waxay noqon lahayd firfircoonida kale. Nasasho degan oo wada-jir ah oo aan shaashad lahayn had iyo jeer waa ikhtiyaar.
reasons.turns: Ma jiro nooc warqad ah oo ciyaartan leh. Si aad lammaanayaasha miiska ugu raadiso, ka daabac kaararka sawirka ee Lammaanayaasha sawirka, kadibna wada rogid, mid waliba kaar ha u rogo.
reasons.screen: Ma jiro nooca warqadda. Tani waa sawir lagu eego shaashad hal mar iyo mar, wadajir ahaan. Sawir jacayl leh ama kaarka boostada ee miiska saaran ayaa isla shaqada qabanaya.
reasons.wash: Ma jiro nooca warqadda hadda. Rinjiga biyaha ee warqadda ku dhex milmaya waa isla fikradda: burush qoyan iyo hal midab mar kasta.
reasons.sayings: Weli ma jiro nooca warqadda. Warqadda dhexdeeda dhammaan dhammaadyada waa la arki lahaa hal mar, tallaabada tartiib ah ee "Tus dhammaadka" waa la lumin lahaa. Ku akhri odayaasha shaashadda wadajir, ama is-weydaarso kuwa aad labaduba garanaysaan.
